mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 2,300,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and durable demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 2300.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 109.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both HOUST > 2300.0 and RSAFS > 360000.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 198.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers forward-looking rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 198.0 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 4.6%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.8% signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 4.8%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 11,250 billion, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 200.0), indicates a healthy economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 11250.0 and CPIAUCSL < 200.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
